title: INDESCRIBABLE
tagline: Thank God for His indescribable gift.
focus_line: Grace is the undeserved kindness and power of God working in us and for us.

verse.text: Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!

session.instruction: On this day of thanks, tell people specifically how they have been a blessing to you — spoken, written, or face to face.

coaching_notes: On the day built for gratitude, get specific. Don't just feel thankful in general — tell people exactly how they've been a blessing to you. A text, a call, or look them in the eye. Specific gratitude lands differently than the vague kind, and it hands a little of God's indescribable gift right back to those who originally handed it to you.
